dashboard_update_protocol.purpose: Defines how AI agents and humans keep this dashboard accurate.
when_to_update: After filing or closing an issue that affects scope (file an updated counter in summary.* and a row under the relevant section)
After merging a plan PR (run refresh-data.py to re-sync plans[])
After landing a feature claimed in the dashboard (move from in_progress -> done with evidence URL)
After publishing a new artefact (add a new top-level key, schema_version 1.0)
Before declaring a session complete (verify dashboard reflects current state)

how_to_update.manual_edits: Edit docs/dashboard/data/dashboard-data.json directly for sections refresh-data.py does not yet generate (parity_status, feature_360_status, gto_compliance_catalogue, etc). Always bump schema_version when extending shape.
how_to_update.commit_convention: PR REQUIRED (branch protection): always create a feature branch (e.g. chore/dashboard-refresh-YYYYMMDD), commit there, open PR to development. PRs running gitleaks must pass. Title format: "chore(dashboard): <reason>". Self-merge with --admin --squash --delete-branch once green.
how_to_update.verify_locally: Open docs/dashboard/index.html in a browser (file:// works) and confirm new section renders
how_to_update.branch_strategy: NEVER push directly to development (branch-protected as of 2026-05-08T10:56Z, requires gitleaks). Create a feature branch even for data-only refreshes. Bundle dashboard updates with the PR that motivated them when possible. For automated 2h sweep refreshes: branch chore/dashboard-2h-sweep-<TIMESTAMP>, open PR, self-merge when CI green.
how_to_update.removed_2026_05_08: The [skip ci] direct-push path for data-only updates is RETIRED. Branch protection enforces PR + gitleaks. No exceptions — even data-only.

what_to_update.plans: Auto-generated by refresh-data.py from docs/plans/**; do not hand-edit
what_to_update.operator_blockers: Hand-curated list of items only the human operator can resolve

rules_for_agents: Anti-laziness: never claim 'I'll update the dashboard later' — update it in the same PR/session as the change
Evidence required: every status change needs a URL (PR/commit/issue) in evidence_url field, no orphan claims
Schema versioning: when extending a section, bump its schema_version (1.0 -> 1.1 -> ...). Major shape changes require dashboard-data.json schema validation regen
Human-readable: every new section should answer 'what does this tell the operator at a glance?' — include human-readable counts/labels, not opaque IDs
Truthful counters: if you cannot verify a count from primary state (issues/PRs/files), do not invent it — use null and explain in `note`
No orphan keys: every top-level key must be rendered by index.html OR documented in this protocol as 'data-only, machine-consumable'
verification_workflow: 1. Make change (file issue, close issue, merge PR, ship plan)
2. git checkout -b chore/dashboard-<reason>-YYYYMMDD off latest origin/development
3. Edit docs/dashboard/data/dashboard-data.json (or run refresh-data.py for auto sections)
4. Run bash docs/dashboard/inline-data.sh to inline into index.html
5. Open docs/dashboard/index.html in browser; verify the affected section renders correctly
6. git add + commit with message: chore(dashboard): <reason>
7. git push -u origin <branch> && gh pr create --base development
8. Wait for gitleaks + other checks to pass (typically <2 min)
10. After merge to development, hourly cron + deploy workflow ships to https://garyocean428.github.io/bsuite/dashboard/
common_mistakes: Forgetting to run inline-data.sh after editing dashboard-data.json (HTML stays stale)
Editing index.html directly (will be overwritten on next inline)
Updating counters without filing the underlying issue (claims without evidence)
Hand-editing the plans[] array (it's auto-generated; edit the source plan .md files instead)
Trying to push directly to development (now branch-protected since 2026-05-08T10:56Z, requires PR + gitleaks)
Forgetting to fast-forward fetch before branching (multi-agent context — origin/development advances every few minutes)
